title: "memhit"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: merging-dfs

library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)

data_folder <- file.path(
  Sys.getenv("HOME"),
  "Desktop",
  "data 2"
)

csv_files <- list.files(
  path = data_folder,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

memhit_task <- map_dfr(
  csv_files,
  ~ read_csv(.x, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
)

MTQ <- read_csv(
  file.path(Sys.getenv("HOME"), "Desktop", "MTQ.csv")
)

id_mappings <- read_csv(
  file.path(Sys.getenv("HOME"), "Desktop", "id_mappings_recent.csv")
)

id_mappings <- id_mappings |>
  mutate(as.character(participant_id))

memhit_task <- memhit_task |>
  filter(participant %in% id_mappings$prolific_pid |
         participant %in% id_mappings$participant_id) |>
  rename(prolific_pid = participant)

merged_data <- memhit_task |>
  left_join(
    MTQ,
    by = c("prolific_pid" = "participant")
  )
```
